text:
sara_mkt: Heads-up  co-hosted webinar with Nimbus Partners next Wed. Need regional reg pages (NA / EMEA / APAC), interpretation channels, and lead enrichment flow. Can owners confirm owners + quick plan?

ola_ops: I'll own Zoom config and interpretation setup. Plan: enable interpretation channels for Spanish + Portuguese + Mandarin, assign interpreters as co-hosts, disable attendee annotation, record host + interpretation audio tracks separately if possible.

diego_partners: Nimbus will provide speaker assets and one localized landing copy per region. I'll consolidate and drop into the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Example.

zoe_access: Accessibility checklist: automated captions (English), human-reviewed SRT for all languages, alt-text for slides, and a plain-text transcript for screen-reader users. Also add a short live-audio phone line for low-bandwidth attendees.

nate_growth: Lead flow: registration -> Zapier enrich (Clearbit) -> HubSpot create/update contact + region property. Routing rules: NA -> SD-R, EMEA -> AE-EMEA, APAC -> AE-APAC. Add a boolean field `partner_interest` for Nimbus leads.

sara_mkt: Good. Also want regional landing pages to show local time automatically. Use this snippet on the page: 
```
<script>document.getElementById('time').innerText = new Date().toLocaleString()</script>
```
(keeps it simple for templates)

ola_ops: Zoom notes: webinar mode. Cloud recording: enabled; separate audio tracks for interpreter channels set to ON. RTMP fallback configured to rtmp://cdn-fallback.example.com/live if Zoom fails. Also increase participant capacity to 3k for APAC slot.

diego_partners: Nimbus speaker backup: if their speaker cancels, they can supply a 10m pre-recorded segment; if not, we switch to our recorded demo as contingency. Please confirm clip branding rules (co-brand logo safe zone).

zoe_access: For transcripts we need to run PII scrub before public replay. Who owns PII QA? cc @sara_mkt

sara_mkt: I'll own PII QA for transcripts. Zoe send the checklist and I'll sign off.

nate_growth: Zapier test passed: zapier-bot -> posted sample enriched lead. Zap details: Trigger = new registrant, Action = Clearbit Enrich, then HubSpot upsert. Zapier result: company_size + role appended. (zapier-bot: TEST OK)

zapier-bot: Zap run (test): 1 registrant enriched, company_size=51-200, role=Engineering.

ola_ops: Quick infra command for RTMP fallback if needed:
```
# enable fallback
zoomctl set --meeting 555111 --rtmp rtmp://cdn-fallback.example.com/live --enable-fallback true
```

diego_partners: Landing pages: we'll include a partner opt-in checkbox for co-marketing. Need legal signoff for data sharing. Sam from legal is on it.

zoe_access: Reminder on recording retention: for EMEA attendees we must keep recordings only for 30 days unless explicit consent. Set retention policy per-region.

ola_ops: Noted. Set retention: NA=90d, EMEA=30d, APAC=60d. Also enable region-specific watermarking: attendee email in lower-left on replay.

sara_mkt: Post-event plan: 
- Within 2 hours: publish internal private MP4 + SRTs to s3://redwood-marketing/partners/nimbus/{date}/
- 6 hours: clips (top 4 highlights) created and reviewed for PII, owners: @matt_social + @diego_partners
- 12-24 hours: public replay page + localized captions + partner-gated asset form.

nate_growth: Sales cadence: 
- Partner-qualified leads -> AE within 12h.
- Partner-interest = true -> high priority.
- Enrichment flag company_size>1000 -> enterprise queue.

sara_mkt: Social plan: staggered posts by region with local times and localized copy. Use UTM template: `?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=nimbus_launch_{region}`

zoe_access: Also ensure accessible download of slides (PDF tagged) and a short alt-text summary for each slide on the replay page.

diego_partners: Nimbus asks for a joint follow-up email sent ~24h after with partner CTA and co-branded one-sheet. Draft will be in the folder.

ola_ops: Final preflight checklist for tomorrow:
- interpreters confirm + rehearsal (30m)
- RTMP fallback test (done)
- retention & watermark rules set (done)
- registration pages live and timezone-checked (done)
- zapier -> clearbit -> hubspot mapping validated (done)

sara_mkt: Who is monitoring chat during the event? We need two people per region: one social + one ops.

matt_social: I'll take NA social + clipping. @nate_growth will watch APAC leads during replay window.

nate_growth: Will stand by. Also request a DM channel with @diego_partners for any on-the-fly partner questions.

sara_mkt: Great. Closing notes: copy owners double-check co-brand logo placement, legal signoff by EOD, and Zoe will send PII QA checklist. See you in rehearsal. :white_check_mark:
